caption: The drawing features two main objects arranged vertically on a light beige background. At the top, there is an illustration of an armchair with curved wooden legs, a carved wooden frame, and scroll-like armrests. The wooden parts are colored brown with shading to indicate dimension. The seat, backrest, and armrest pads are upholstered in a pale cream or off-white fabric. Below the chair, roughly centered, there is a rectangular textile or tapestry design. This textile has a tan or light brown background decorated with repeated wavy, scallop patterns and a central motif of stylized flowers and leaves in colors such as green, red, blue, and brown. The stitched design also contains some black outline work and shading, contributing to the overall texture. In the bottom right corner of the textile section, the name "Edith Olney" is inscribed in black text. The two illustrations are separated by empty space, and there is a faint rectangular border marking the composition area.
title: Chair and Tapestry
